provider: International Committee on Taxonomy of Viruses (ICTV)
sourceNotes: ICTV states that MSL41.v1 is the current official taxonomy and that the VMR is the definitive current source for exemplar-virus metadata.
ICTV's 2026-07-29 release notice says the earlier 2026-07-21 VMR contained errors and should be discarded.

The corrected workbook embeds DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21694279 and the live Zenodo API record contains the same filename, byte count and MD5. The older DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21476703 still shown in the release-news prose returned HTTP 410 during this audit, so it is not used as the pinned artifact identifier.

The raw XLSX files are not committed. Their immutable ICTV URLs, Zenodo checksums and locally computed SHA-256 values are fixed here; the compact derived snapshot is committed for offline reproducibility within the source budget.

matchingPolicy.accepted: One exact case-sensitive COL scientificName match to one current MSL41.v1 Species row, with one unique ICTV_ID shared by MSL and VMR.
matchingPolicy.redirect: No redirect was used. Historical names and the MSL renamed-or-abolished sheet are not substituted for current COL records.
matchingPolicy.ambiguous: More than one exact current MSL row or conflicting ICTV IDs.
matchingPolicy.unmatched: No exact current MSL41.v1 Species match.
matchingPolicy.withheld: The COL source sector is not ICTV MSL, or the official workbook identity/integrity cannot be proved.

limitations: MSL and VMR are taxonomy and exemplar-virus metadata sources, not evidence that viruses are cellular life or that a named species has a curated Evo Atlas fossil, morphology, ecology, distribution, phylogeny or expert-review dossier.
GenBank accession strings and links are preserved from the pinned VMR. Evo Atlas did not independently query NCBI to revalidate every accession.
The two current ICTV species absent from the COL26.8 accepted-species shard are shipped as explicit ICTV-only records with null COL IDs; no COL IDs or placements are invented.
